column1: # ops/schedule.tsv: every generated artifact the freshness contract adds (watch/freshness/SPEC.md FR-O.1), one row each.
# Columns, tab-separated: artifact, generator command, workflow file, cadence, gate that fails when the
# committed artifact differs from a fresh run, and snapshot_built (YYYY-MM-DD for a vendored snapshot, else -).
# Artifacts that existed before 2026-09-25 are out of scope. `node ops/schedule.mjs` checks this file (gate W3).
# watch/live.json and watch/crossings.jsonl come from GitHub API facts that are not committed, so W3 cannot
# re-run the watch offline: it checks the committed files' schema, key order, size and ledger order
# (cases CORE-L1-committed, CORE-G3-committed), and proves the byte-equal render on the recorded fixture
# (CORE-L1-deterministic). The other rows are re-rendered from committed files and compared byte for byte.
